source_artifact.content_excerpt: T12-F3-3 (primary): 'Budget envelope: replace per-decision yes/no with a once-set spend threshold' -- the operator sets a run-scoped budget envelope once, spend-increasing choices below the remaining envelope proceed silently, and only a choice that would cross it asks. Merged with T12-F6-6 (spec-level cost_budget HALT mirroring VERIFY_N_CAP), T12-F4-8 (shared ordinal cost_weights.json + to_spend() helper), T3-F5-7 (Kubernetes ResourceQuota/QoS-class framing for a run-level ceiling), and X-codex-15 (effort escrow: per-unit spendable budget with refund/escalation semantics).
